race.comment: HELLBERG (1) showed good early speed and led into the straight before fading to finish fourth, beaten 4.5 lengths, over 1454m at Kyneton. Sound record at this distance with 2 wins and 3 minor placings from 7 runs and looks a top chance. LUMINARY MISS (6) got the maiden win at the first go at 1200m, which gives the impression the step up will suit.Draw hurts though. FRENCH REIGN (5) accounted for a maiden field over 1300m at Avoca last start when fresh from a break. Harder task ahead this time but can measure up, especially from the low draw. NOSTRO ROCCIA (2) didn't make an impact at his last run before going for a spell on August 16, finishing 12th and beaten 14 lengths over 1400m on the Pakenham Synthetic. Lines up today for the first time for trainer Barry Ainsworth and comes here with definite claims. BILLIE BRONX (4) will be better for the fresh run and while she doesn't have a great second-up record, she's won 3 times at the trip.
